opportunities.title: Laravel DevOps Unicorn 🦄
opportunities.descriptionText: All open rolesREMOTE / LIMASSOL, CYPRUSFULL-TIMEStackLaravel · Cloudflare · AWSDevOps EngineerWe're looking to onboard another unicorn — this time, one who feels equally comfortable inside Laravel, Linux, Cloudflare and AWS. Not someone whose answer to every problem is “the server looks fine”: a DevOps engineer who deeply understands the applications running on the infrastructure, can follow a Laravel request all the way through queues, Redis, workers, databases and WebSockets, and isn't afraid to open the codebase when infrastructure and application behaviour start overlapping. Our infrastructure spans DigitalOcean, Laravel Forge, Laravel Cloud, AWS and Cloudflare Enterprise, supporting multiple interconnected applications, APIs, workers, real-time systems and a large domain network. In other words: this isn't keeping a few Ubuntu boxes alive.Annual salaryUp to€100k+ Highly competitive bonus packageSalary by levelSenior€75k–100k🦄Unicorn€100k+, no ceiling€75k€100k+This seat is hired at senior level and above — where you land depends on your experience and the impact you bring. Unicorns don’t have a ceiling.Apply nowLaravel sits at the centre of our ecosystem, so strong Laravel knowledge matters here — and you should be comfortable around our Nuxt and Vue applications even if you never build a frontend component. The environment: Laravel and modern PHP, Nuxt and Vue, Livewire, Alpine, Nova, MySQL, Redis, REST APIs, WebSockets and high-frequency queues, running on Laravel Cloud, a tailor-made AWS setup, DigitalOcean App Platform, Laravel Forge and Ubuntu — managed platforms where they are enough, considerably more control where they are not.Cloudflare is a major part of the picture rather than an afterthought: hundreds of domains run through Cloudflare Enterprise — DNS, WAF and security rules, redirects, SSL/TLS, origins, caching, geographic access rules — and hands-on Cloudflare experience is required. Managing hundreds of domains by hand gets boring very quickly, so a big part of this role is building the internal tooling that manages infrastructure at scale: if something needs doing 100 times, your first instinct should be “why are we doing this manually?”. The same applies to observability — a green deployment badge doesn't mean everything is fine, and because our applications run across different markets, what a user actually sees from a particular GEO matters as much as whether the origin returned 200. When something breaks, we want to know before someone tells us on Slack. We work with GitHub Actions, CodeRabbit, SonarQube, PHPStan, Sentry and Laravel Nightwatch, with AI-powered engineering workflows wired straight into Slack — AI is already part of how we operate, as a tool for removing repetitive work while still understanding what is happening underneath.What you'll ownMaintain and evolve the infrastructure behind our Laravel and Nuxt applications across Laravel Cloud, AWS, DigitalOcean App Platform and Laravel ForgeRun Ubuntu-based environments and production services; keep Redis, queues, workers and real-time infrastructure healthy and fastUnderstand how Laravel applications behave in production rather than treating them as black boxes, and support the deployment and runtime needs of Nuxt and VueManage hundreds of domains through Cloudflare Enterprise, and build the tools that automate Cloudflare, domain, DNS, certificate and infrastructure managementImprove deployment and CI/CD workflows; automate server configuration, environment management and every repetitive operational process you canBuild and maintain uptime and infrastructure monitoring, including checks from multiple geographic locations and the systems that proxy requests through different GEOs for testingInvestigate production incidents across both layers — performance, networking, DNS, SSL, caching, connectivity — and work closely with developers when the line between application problem and infrastructure problem blursImprove security, reliability, scalability and observability across the platform, documenting the decisions that matterWhat you bringStrong professional experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering or infrastructure, operating production cloud infrastructureDeep understanding of Laravel and its production architecture, PHP deployment and runtime behaviour, and how a request moves through queues, workers, Redis, schedulers and WebSocketsStrong Linux and Ubuntu experienceStrong hands-on Cloudflare experience — ideally Cloudflare Enterprise — managing DNS, WAF rules, SSL/TLS, caching, redirects and networking at scaleExperience with AWS and DigitalOceanExperience with CI/CD and GitHub-based workflowsStrong understanding of HTTP, DNS, networking, proxies and TLSStrong monitoring and production-debugging skills, able to diagnose issues across both the application and infrastructure layersAbility to automate infrastructure and operational workflows through APIs and scripting rather than dashboardsStrong sense of ownership and reliability, with clear and early communicationNice to haveLaravel Cloud, Laravel Forge and DigitalOcean App PlatformNuxt and Vue.js deploymentsHigh-frequency queues, large Redis workloads, WebSockets and real-time systemsManaging large numbers of domains and building internal infrastructure-management toolsMulti-region or geographically distributed systems; testing services through proxies from different locationsInfrastructure-as-code and automated provisioningHigh-volume transactional, gaming, fintech, CRM or similarly complex platformsRemunerationSenior and unicorn onlyGreat engineers get paid like great engineers.We don't believe in forcing everyone into the same salary bracket regardless of what they bring to the table. Remuneration is aligned with your actual level, experience and technical impact — and this seat is hired at senior level and above.If you can understand Laravel deeply, design reliable infrastructure, tame Cloudflare at scale, automate away repetitive work and remain suspiciously calm when production gets interesting, we're prepared to recognise that accordingly.In shortThe stronger the unicorn, the better the package.The BenefitscompensationTop-of-market payIndustry-leading base comp plus aggressive bonus packages. If you're a unicorn, you're paid like one.time offPaid annual leavePaid time off for both contractors and local employees. Take a proper break, then come back sharper.momentsReal giftsBirthdays and work anniversaries come with actual gifts, not just Slack emojis.processPaid trialsIf we ask for practical work, it is paid at a premium rate from the first hour.equipmentPremium Apple gearTop-spec hardware and peripherals, always bought new for you.healthGym allowanceYour membership is on us. Sharp minds need healthy bodies.foodLunch on usDaily delivery-platform credits to order what you actually want.peopleElite teamInternational, ambitious colleagues selected purely on talent and output.ApplicationApply for this role.Submit your details and CV. We will review your application and contact you if there is a fit.Hiring processWhat happens after you apply.01Within a few daysHR introductionA first conversation to understand your background and make sure there's a good overall fit — on both sides.02Within 1 weekTechnical testA practical exercise designed around the kind of problems you could actually encounter with us. Paid at a premium rate from the first hour.03Within 2 weeksTeam callMeet the people you'd actually work with, discuss the exercise, dive into our infrastructure and architecture, and make sure the fit works both ways. If everyone is happy, you get a top-of-the-line offer. opportunities.title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrations
opportunities.descriptionText: You need to enable JavaScript to run this app. GivebutterSenior Software Engineer, Integrations LocationRemote; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Indianapolis, IN; Los Angeles, CA; Minneapolis, MN; Nashville, TN; New York, NY; Salt Lake City, UT; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WAEmployment TypeFull timeLocation TypeRemoteDepartmentProduct, Design, and EngineeringEngineeringDeadline to ApplyOctober 16, 2026 at 7:00 AM UTCCompensation$170K – $185K • Offers EquityOverviewApplicationCompany DescriptionGivebutter is the most-loved nonprofit fundraising and CRM platform, empowering millions of changemakers to raise more, pay less, and give better. Nonprofits use Givebutter to replace multiple tools so they can launch fundraisers and events, use donation forms and donor management (CRM), send emails and text blasts—all in one place. Use of the Givebutter platform is completely free with a 100% transparent tip-or-fee model.Givebutter has been certified as a Great Place to Work® every year since 2021, and is the #1 rated nonprofit software company on G2 across multiple categories.Our mission is to empower the changemaker in all of us. We believe giving should be fun, so you’ll want to do it again, and we also believe that work should be fun, so that you’ll have the greatest impact. We are excited to hear from talented people who want to work with other talented people in making the world a butter place—and have fun along the way. Role DescriptionGivebutter is hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Integrations, to join our Growth pod. Nonprofits live inside dozens of tools they already love: CRMs, accounting, volunteer platforms, AI assistants. This role decides how well Givebutter meets them there. You'll shape our public API into something builders and their AI agents actually want to reach for, and hold the partner surfaces we care about most as they grow with us.Most of this work happens in the space between two systems: reading partner docs, spiking to see what breaks, sitting on calls with external engineers, closing the ambiguity that turns "maybe we could" into "here's how."Why join the Givebutter Engineering team?Democracy of code. We value equal contributions from all engineers and foster an environment of open discussion on architecture and ideas.Autonomy in work. We keep meetings to a minimum. Engineers have the freedom to manage their own calendars and block out uninterrupted time for focused work.Automated CI/CD. Our build and deployment processes are fully automated and hands-off, allowing engineers to focus on problem-solving through code.Mission-driven, full stop. You'll be working with inspiring nonprofits, charities, and organizations that are making a positive impact around the world.Peer ownership of production surfaces. You'll take an integration or an API surface and hold it, cycle over cycle, as sales, success, and product shape it further.AI-native workflow. We use terminal-based agents (Claude Code and similar) daily. We review what they hand us. You'll have opinions about your setup, and we'll want to hear them.We want to hear from people who…Read someone else's API docs carefully, and know why the choices in them matterCare as much about the person calling the API as the person writing itKnow that a good integration keeps a nonprofit inside the tools they already love, instead of dragging them into oursSpike, learn what breaks, and turn that into an engineering conversation without needing a project manager to translateGet on a call with a partner engineer and come out with less ambiguity than you startedTake your development setup seriously (terminal, editor, agent) and have probably built one or two custom skills to make them work harderResponsibilitiesOwn one or more of our partner integration surfaces end-to-end, and hold them coherent as sales, success, and product shape them furtherShape our public API as its audience grows to include AI agents building on behalf of nonprofits who don't code themselvesSpike, prototype, and de-risk new partnerships, including the ones we don't yet know how to build, and the ones that only ship because someone had an aha momentDesign and defend API contracts, webhook shapes, and data flows that other engineers (and other agents) will build against for yearsPartner with an existing integrations lead on the surfaces they hold today, and grow into shared ownership over timePartner with Product, Growth, Marketing, and occasionally an external partner engineer, as a natural translator between what each group needsRequirements4+ years shipping production backend services, ideally on a modern web frameworkStrong proficiency in PHP / Laravel, or the kind of adjacent framework fluency that ramps quickly (we won't rule you out for having lived in Rails, Django, or Spring)Deep familiarity with REST API design, HTTP semantics, and the patterns that make an API worth building againstSolid SQL, MySQL specifically or comfortable enough with another relational database to speak to the trade-offs you've madeExperience building against real-world third-party APIs, not just the pristine documented examplesComfortable designing async job workflows, queued work, and observable failure pathsStrong instincts around OAuth, webhooks, and the trust-boundary decisions that keep a public API safe and honestActive use of terminal-based AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) with a clear review discipline for what the agent producesExperience contributing to on-call rotation for production servicesComfortable navigating an existing monorepo (ours is real, and PHP / Laravel is most of the backend)Nice to haveContributions to a public API you helped design (bonus if it survived a v2)You've built your own AI tooling, custom skills, or agent workflows, not just used the defaultsFamiliarity with the emerging surface where AI agents consume APIs on behalf of end users, and opinions about what a legible API looks like to a non-human callerYou have opinions about the difference between a specification and an implementation (OAuth 1 vs 2, JSON:API vs REST, GraphQL and what came after: any of it, all of it)Nonprofit or mission-driven experienceMore about GivebutterBenefitsRemote Work: Work remotely from one of our 10 hubs (Austin, Denver, Indianapolis, Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Salt Lake City, Minneapolis, Seattle, and Nashville). Health Insurance: We offer Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance covered 100% for employees as well as HSA and FSA accounts.Dependent Care Coverage: We offer coverage for dependents, with 50% of Medical, Dental, and Vision premiums covered for all eligible dependents.Mental Health: Givebutter health insurance plans come with access to a TalkSpace membership.401k: We offer a 3% 401k match for all eligible employee's. Vacation and Holidays: Givebutter offers a Flexible PTO policy with uncapped vacation days and company-recognized holidays.Wellness Week: Givebutter closes for one week each summer to prioritize rest and recharge for the entire team.Parental Leave: We offer 12 weeks of paid leave for all parents and comprehensive leave planning management through Aidora.Family Care Support: Access a company-paid UrbanSitter membership plus care credits to book trusted, background-checked caregivers for childcare, senior care, pet care, and household support when you need it most.Home Office Stipend: Upgrade your home office with company-sponsored expenses, including high-quality laptops, monitors, and modern technology.Coworking Stipend: Enjoy a monthly stipend that gives you the freedom to work from coworking spaces or cafés whenever you need connection, community, or a change of scenery.Charitable Giving: Employees are encouraged to donate up to $50/month to any verified nonprofit they wish to support on Givebutter.Professional Development: We offer learning and development reimbursement opportunities.Love What You Do: We are a mission-driven company serving the charitable sector. Feel good about the work you're doing and the company you work for.Interview ProcessBelow is a high-level outline of our standard interview processRecruiter Screen: A 30-minute conversation to learn more about your background, walk through the role, and ensure mutual alignment on expectations, values, and logistics.Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper dive into your relevant experience, skillset, and working style. This is your first opportunity to connect directly with the person who may be your future manager.Assessment (technical or non-technical): This stage will vary based on the role. It could involve a live coding session, case study, or take-home project. Some roles may include two parts to this stage to evaluate both practical skills and problem-solving approachesValues Interview: A conversation with team members focused on how you align with our core values and leadership principles. opportunities.title: Product Engineer (Laravel - Remote)
opportunities.descriptionText: Share this job SVGs not supported by this browser.Descriptiontldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it: https://hsptb.com/hndbk We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help them with more of their problems.Feel free to join in one of our upcoming Townhalls on YouTube to experience it for yourself: https://hsptb.com/twnhll Hospitable.com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones, not countries.The Product: Core & GrowthOur Core platform is comprised of properties, calendar, messaging, metrics, operations, and guest experience. The Growth component is about guiding our customers through sign-up, their first experiences with our platform, setting them up for success, helping them adopt our features and ultimately growing their own businesses with Hospitable. Our more than 22,000 customers rely on our core and connectivity product to manage $500M+ in monthly reservations. To help with maintaining and improving Hospitable’s core platform and growth strategies, our remote-first, fully-distributed team is looking for a Senior Product Engineer to maintain momentum and stability."Working at Hospitable is both the most intense and the most rewarding professional experiences of my life. The momentum isn't for everyone, neither is the laser focus on shipping value, but the right person will flourish and grow here more so than just about anywhere else." - Nik, Principal Product Engineer.What you will be working onYou will be diving deep into our foundational codebase, which glues together our entire product lines, to develop new features, maintain existing features, and build product workflows that help our customers grow. Your work will have a direct impact on thousands of customers’ short-term rental operations.Add your voice to product shaping discussions, ship new core platform features 0→1, and iterate based on customer feedback.Work with Ben whose favourite fruit is Strawberry. Use your software engineering chops to build magical user experiences, which are both simple for customers to use and simple for other engineers to understand and maintain.Partner with product, sales, customer success, and other engineers to develop and ship features that solve the right problems.Work within our “majestic” monolithic codebase, sitting on a Kubernetes-powered infrastructure-as-code stack.Implement and use observability tooling to track and debug post-deployment.Seek out and remedy performance/resource issues and feature bugs that have the most impact on business operations and customer experience.Refactor core platform code to make it easier to understand, maintain, and test.As an engineering team we are all in on Laravel and Angular. Our self-defined tech stack acronym is 🌴 PALM-B; PHP, Angular, Laravel, MySQL and Beanstalk.We consider ourselves AI forward, all in on Cursor 🤖. 90-95% of the code we ship to production is AI generated. It's made us a lot faster. It makes the reviewing part even more important, so you'll need to actually understand what's being written on your behalf before it gets shipped to our customers.RequirementsHospitable is a remote-only and distributed company. For this position, your location is not a requirement. The ideal fit could work under European or American (up to East Coast) timezones.Don’t tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you’re still an amazing fit. In the meantime, here’s what we’re paying attention to:5+ years of software engineering experience, with a focus on backend technologies.Significant experience with Laravel, PHP 7+, MySQL, and testing pipelines in a deployed web application used by paying customers. We are all in on Laravel; this is non-negotiable.Hands-on with agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or similar) in a real production codebase, not just side projects.An eye for testable, maintainable, and intuitive code, but also...The mentality of “Code is a means, not an end,” avoids unnecessary abstraction. Your compass points toward customer and business value.The ability to think through non-obvious usage scenarios and explore ripple effects within complex systems.High degree of empathy both toward customers and teammates.Exceptional communication skills - especially written. We are a remote-first, fully distributed company. Most communication happens on Slack and Notion.Self-motivated and able to make decisions when surrounded by uncertainty. You don’t require a support system to maintain momentum.Experience with queue/job-centric backends is a plus.Experience with building production systems where data ingestion from third-party APIs is critical to the business is a big plus.BenefitsThe company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.The total budget for this role is between USD$134,450.00 - USD $167,258.30 depending on the cost of living in your location. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For US employees, the gross compensation could be anywhere between USD$123,993.09 - USD$154,249.72.We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a grant value of up to $76,026.50, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional $380,895.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.Apply for this job

opportunities.title: Senior Fullstack PHP/Laravel Developer – Remote (Europe/Berlin Time Zone)
opportunities.descriptionText: Back to Jobs Senior Fullstack PHP/Laravel Developer – Remote (Europe/Berlin Time Zone) Eventhub GmbH Open Company Description Eventhub develops digital solutions that transform major sporting events into exceptional experiences for fans. Our platform combines interactive maps, live data, and location-based information, helping fans follow their favorite athletes, discover what's happening next, and never miss a highlight – whether they're at the event or following from home. We create measurable value for event organizers: We enhance the fan experience, improve navigation and communication, provide valuable insights into fan behavior, and open up new opportunities for sponsors to engage with their audiences at the right place and time. Eventhub powers digital experiences at some of the world's most prestigious sporting events, including the PGA Championship, Ryder Cup, and DP World Tour. What started in golf has expanded well beyond the fairways. Today, our technology connects fans with tennis, motorsport, and winter sports – from international ATP tournaments to the legendary Nürburgring 24 Hours. Our technology stack includes Laravel, MapLibre, live data integrations, and modern APIs. As a small, agile team, we continuously develop and improve our platform. You'll take ownership early, contribute your ideas, and directly shape our products – without layers of management or lengthy approval processes. We're a remote-first team based in Germany. You can work from anywhere, with no requirement to live in or travel to Germany. What matters is that your working hours align with the Europe/Berlin time zone, allowing us to collaborate effectively as a team. Benefits - Fully remote position with flexible working hours and collaboration during Europe/Berlin business hours - Real ownership of features used at major live sporting events - Fast decisions and direct impact: Your ideas can shape our architecture instead of getting lost in a ticket backlog - Claude Code licenses provided - Opportunities to attend sporting events and experience our platform in action Role and Responsibilities What you'll do -Develop new features and improve existing functionality on our Laravel platform. -Build and maintain interactive mapping features using MapLibre. -Integrate external systems from the sports and events industry. -Improve platform reliability, performance, and maintainability, especially under the high traffic demands of live events. -Help manage our infrastructure across Cloudflare, Laravel Cloud, and Laravel Forge. What we're looking for - Several years of professional experience with PHP and Laravel - Experience with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS - Experience hosting and deploying Laravel applications, ideally using Cloudflare, Laravel Cloud, or Laravel Forge - An independent, proactive approach to work and the ability to make technical decisions with the bigger picture in mind - Regular use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex, with a strong sense of responsibility for reviewing and testing the code you ship - Excellent English communication skills - Ability to work primarily during Europe/Berlin business hours (CET/CEST) Nice to have - Experience with MapLibre, Mapbox, Leaflet, or GIS - Experience with real-time features (WebSockets, Laravel Reverb, queues) - An interest in sports and live events Interested? We'd love to hear from you! Submit your application through the form below. Apply for this Position

opportunities.title: Web Designer, eCRM
opportunities.descriptionText: Headquarters: Humane World for Animals URL: https://humaneworld.org The general salary range for this full-time position is $80,000 – 115,000. Salary offers will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, skills, training and education.   Humane World for Animals, a global leader in animal advocacy and protection, is seeking a Web Developer, eCRM to support Digital Marketing and other departments by providing front-end, global web development solutions for fundraising, advocacy engagement, and other strategic priorities — incorporating AI-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous human oversight, quality, and security standards.   Responsibilities: Collaborates regularly with Digital Marketing, Brand and Visuals, and IS teams to discuss project requirements and makes technical recommendations. Writes efficient code and maintains custom donation forms, advocacy forms, other webpages, and email templates. Incorporates best practices for user experience, accessibility, page speed optimization, and GDPR compliance implementation. Adheres to global regulations and standards, regional data compliance, and security compliance; Uses AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding assistants to accelerate coding, refactoring, debugging, testing, and documentation. Proactively identifies opportunities for AI-assisted and agent-built solutions and owns the ongoing maintenance, monitors their performance over time and updates or retires them as needed. Follows established guardrails and usage standards for AI tools and applies human-in-the-loop review to all AI-generated code and configurations, validating output for accuracy, security, accessibility, and brand/technical standards before deployment; Follows quality assurance procedures and troubleshoots technical issues affecting donation forms, advocacy forms, webpages, and email templates in Engaging Networks. Works closely with vendor partners; Works with the Information Security team to ensure that digital properties meet security standards, including managing script inventory, attestation, and other requirements for PCI compliance; Collaborates with the testing team to gather testing requirements and implement new features to run A/B and multivariate tests on forms; Creates and maintains clear and concise documentation of custom web development, support guides, and incident reports; Performs other duties as assigned.    Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer programming, web development, or related field, or equivalent work experience required;  A minimum of four (4) years of experience in front-end web development and developing custom websites required; Demonstrated experience with Engaging Networks or other eCRMs; Proficient in HTML5, Sass and CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL, GitHub, Engaging Networks modules, Webpack, Node, npm, core AWS services, and Mailgun. Familiar with Segment or other CDPs; Direct experience with AI coding assistants and agentic development tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot; Knowledge of best practices for responsive, mobile-first web design, UX, accessibility, page speed optimization, browser support, and GDPR compliance; Familiar with cookie consent tools, preferably Iubenda, for configuring compliance settings; Experience building interactive data visualizations that translate campaigns into compelling stories for supporters to increase engagement; Excellent attention to detail when coding projects based on Adobe XD files or Figma; Understanding of digital marketing strategies for US and international audiences; Stays on top of AI trends in web development, including personalization and workflow automation, and their responsible application to fundraising and advocacy technology; Strong written and verbal communication skills; Must be able to multi-task in a fast-paced, collaborative environment to deliver high quality work on deadline. Familiarity with Jira and Confluence a plus; Data informed problem solver having experience with A/B testing platforms and Google Analytics; Proactive and ability to work both independently and as an effective team member in a team environment; Interest in animal protection issues preferred.   This is a full-time remote position based in the United States. Candidates must be able to accomodate Eastern Time hours, as needed.    Q ualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, and disability, marital or parental status or protected veteran status.  EOE   To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/humane-world-for-animals-web-designer-ecrm-1

opportunities.title: Full-Stack E-commerce Developer with Sage X3 Experience
opportunities.descriptionText: Headquarters: Summary We are seeking a Full-Stack Developer to build or customize a dealer e-commerce platform connected to an existing Sage X3 ERP environment. The role is focused on selecting the right e-commerce approach, implementing the portal, and supporting dealer-facing workflows in a manufacturing context. General information This engagement centers on building an e-commerce portal for dealers on top of an existing Sage X3 ERP setup. The client is open to the e-commerce technology choice and is looking for an experienced developer who can assess the current environment, recommend an appropriate platform approach, and deliver the required solution. The work is fully remote and involves integrating the portal with Sage X3 while supporting the underlying commerce and data flows required for dealer operations. Tasks and Deliverables Assess the current Sage X3 environment and recommend the e-commerce platform approach. Build or customize a dealer e-commerce portal on top of the existing ERP. Integrate the platform with Sage X3 using SOAP and GraphQL APIs. Develop full-stack functionality using the selected commerce stack and supporting technologies. Implement dealer-facing workflows, data exchange, and platform customizations required for launch. Required experience Strong hands-on experience with Sage X3 integration. Proven full-stack development experience with Python and JavaScript. Experience with Node.js, PHP, MySQL, and CSS. Experience working with REST, SOAP and GraphQL APIs. Nice to have: Manufacturing industry experience. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-full-stack-e-commerce-developer-with-sage-x3-experience

opportunities.title: Staff Web Developer – Product and UX Focus
opportunities.descriptionText: Employment Opportunities Staff Web Developer – Product and UX Focus Menu Employment Opportunities Staff Web Developer – Product and UX Focus Multi-System Youth and Family Regional Coach Current Request for Proposals Start Accessibility and Language Toolbar OCALI is recognized as a global leader in creating and connecting resources and relationships to ensure that people with disabilities live their best lives for their whole lives. OCALI is a trusted source of high-quality information, facilitation, coaching, professional development, and technical assistance to ensure families, educators, and service providers are equipped to effectively care for, support, educate, employ, or work with people with disabilities. Our in-house web development team works closely together on a wide range of multifaceted and customized projects. This role contributes to the development of high-quality, accessible, and maintainable websites and web applications for OCALI clients and staff. The Staff Web Developer is a developer-first, product-minded team member who looks beyond the immediate request to understand user needs, clarify goals, identify risks and solution options, and develop accessible, sustainable web solutions that effectively address the underlying problem. This staff member is expected to ask thoughtful questions, contribute technical insight, share knowledge with team members, and support the successful delivery of web solutions. This is a hybrid position based in Central Ohio. The employee must be available to work on-site and collaborate in person at the office as needed for meetings, planning, project coordination, team collaboration, and other job-related responsibilities. Responsibilities and Essential Functions: The following essential functions identify the primary duties required to perform this position, with or without reasonable accommodation. The list is not ranked in order of importance. Develop, test, deploy, modernize, and maintain custom websites, web applications, reusable components, templates, and integrations using established development standards and technology stack. Write clean, maintainable, accessible, and well-documented code that supports consistency, scalability, security, and long-term maintenance. Troubleshoot, test, resolve, and document bugs, accessibility issues, production problems, and other assigned technical needs. Participate in technical planning, solution design, quality assurance, code review, release activities, and improvement of existing websites and applications. Collaborate with product owners, technical project managers, developers, and stakeholders to understand goals, clarify requirements, identify user needs, surface risks or gaps, and translate approved requirements into functional, accessible web solutions. Communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, project status, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Maintain accurate technical documentation for applications, components, workflows, and development standards, and share technical knowledge with team members. Manage assigned work according to identified priorities, including tracking time toward client contract work as required. Perform other specific job-related duties as directed by senior leadership. Minimum Qualifications: Associate degree or higher preferred, or equivalent professional experience. Strong front-end development skills, including HTML, CSS/Sass, JavaScript, responsive layouts, and reusable interface components. Experience with Bootstrap, jQuery, Alpine JS, Livewire, Laravel, Laravel Filament, NPM, and Laravel Mix or similar tools. Experience with Gitflow, pull requests, code review, testing, release practices, and collaborative development workflows. Working knowledge of web accessibility standards and best practices. Demonstrated ability to analyze requirements, ask clarifying questions, identify risks or gaps, provide technical recommendations, and deliver effective web solutions within established priorities and timelines. Ability to communicate technical concepts, recommendations, risks, and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to manage web content and interface details with accuracy, consistency, and sound judgment. Ability to rapidly adapt to changing web technologies and quickly adopt new systems and approaches. Documentation of a clear criminal record in compliance with state statute. Complies with drug-free workplace rules and Board policies. Preferred Qualifications: Experience designing or maintaining component-based interfaces, design systems, or shared front-end patterns. Experience using Figma, Adobe Illustrator, or similar tools to support interface planning and collaboration. Experience with user-centered design, usability testing, product discovery, or related UX practices. What's in it for you? OCALI offers excellent benefits and retirement packages, including eligibility in SERS, as well as access to: A mission-driven, innovative, and growing team (more opportunities are coming!) Health, dental, and vision insurance Paid time off and generous holiday schedule Flexible and collaborative work environment Professional learning opportunities Salary: $80K to $90K, commensurate with experience. Reports To: Senior Web Developer Application Procedures: Please apply online at www.escco.org/careers Job ID 24131 - Staff Web Developer - Product and UX Focus For questions, please contact: nathan_ticknor@ocali.org Close
